Name: Walkable Tide Pools
Author: Kotopoilka3
Description:
Either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] or[i] [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] is required for splash sounds to play while walking through pools.

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
For better compatibility with other mods, you can manually adjust the priority of applying patches to individual locations, or [b]disable[/b] them completely.
- If this mod overrides changes from another mod, set the priority to "[b]Early[/b]".
- If a patch is not being applied because it is overridden by another mod, set the priority to "[b]Late[/b]".

[size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]
The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] version don't plays splash sounds at summer festivals.
